Default head prior for the joint engine: form and weight of the surround penalty

Settings are form:weight in curvature units (1 = prior curvature equal to the measured image curvature at the knee); none is the 6.27.0 default. Forms (syntx.motion_batched.surround_rho): charbonnier (quadratic below the knee, gradient vanishes at zero), sparse (gradient ten times steeper at zero: sub-knee jitter driven to zero, drift and jumps free), cauchy (re-descending). Knee 0.05 mm.

Verdict

Settings passing BOTH gates: cauchy:0.03.
